verdict.rationale: The payment-acceptance docs name USDC and USDT as accepted stablecoins. Other docs name Base as a network (USDC subscriptions on Base) and the SDK mentions EVM and Solana wallets. However, there is no documented supported-assets/networks matrix showing which stablecoins are accepted on which chains. Missing for 10: an explicit per-chain stablecoin support list for payment acceptance, named networks beyond Base for USDT/USDC acceptance, peer stablecoins beyond USDC/USDT, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform documents which stablecoins and chains it supports — USDC, USDT and peers across multiple named networks — so I can match what my customers actually hold
